results.question: My printer is not printing anything
results.answer:
Based on Ticket ID: TKT-031, the issue of the printer not printing could be due to the print spooler on the print server hanging, which can cause print jobs to sit in the queue with an 'Error' status. The resolution involved clearing the stuck jobs, restarting the Print Spooler service, and confirming that a test page printed successfully. 

If you are experiencing similar issues, you may want to check the print spooler status.

results.question: I cannot access SAP after my account was locked
results.answer: To unlock your SAP account, it can be reactivated if it was auto-locked due to dormancy or if you forgot your password. For an account locked due to dormancy, it can be reactivated in transaction SU01, and you will need to log in and change your password to confirm access is restored. This is based on Ticket ID: TKT-048. If your account is locked due to a forgotten password, the password can be reset in transaction SU01 as well. This is based on Ticket ID: TKT-012.

results.question: My laptop screen went black and won't turn on
results.answer: Based on Ticket ID: TKT-019, the resolution for a laptop that will not power on is to isolate the fault. In that case, the issue was determined to be a failed dock power adapter rather than the laptop itself. The recommended steps are to connect the laptop directly to a known-good charger, perform a battery-drain reset, and if necessary, replace the faulty power adapter. After these steps, the laptop should boot normally.

results.question: I need access to Power BI for my team
results.answer:
To grant Power BI access to your team, you can follow a similar process as outlined in Ticket ID: TKT-014. In that case, the analyst was assigned a Power BI Pro license in the Microsoft 365 admin center and added to the Finance workspace as a Viewer. Ensure that your team members have the appropriate licenses and are added to the relevant workspaces. 

If you need further assistance, please refer to the specific licensing requirements and workspace permissions.

results.question: Network drive is not showing up on my computer
results.answer:
Based on Ticket ID: GH-MIC-239224, the issue involves accessing a network share, which is related to troubleshooting network drives. The resolution indicates that the problem was related to UNC network shares. While it doesn't provide a direct troubleshooting guide for a missing network drive, it suggests that issues may arise from how the network share is accessed. 

For troubleshooting, ensure that you are using the correct format for the network share URL and check if the share is properly configured. 

If you need further assistance, please refer to the specifics of your network configuration.

results.question: I forgot my Windows password and am locked out
results.answer:
To reset a forgotten Windows password, you can verify your identity through a manager or employee ID, then reset the Active Directory password and clear any account lockout. After that, you can set a new password at the next logon. This process is similar to what was done in Ticket ID: TKT-007, where the user's identity was verified, and the password was reset. 

Ticket ID: TKT-007.

results.question: VPN disconnects every few minutes while working from home
results.answer: To address frequent VPN disconnections during remote work sessions, you can refer to Ticket ID: TKT-004. The resolution involved tracing the drops to an aggressive idle-timeout on the user's consumer router and a low DPD value in the group policy. The solution was to raise the dead-peer-detection interval on the VPN profile and advise disabling the router's Wi-Fi power-saving mode, which stabilized the session.

results.question: Printer shows offline but is turned on
results.answer: The printer is showing offline because it picked up a new DHCP address while its print queue still pointed at the old IP. To resolve this, a DHCP reservation was set for the printer's MAC, the port on the print server was updated to the new address, and it was confirmed that the queue came back online for all users. This information is based on Ticket ID: TKT-036.

results.question: My email signature is not showing in Outlook
results.answer:
To fix a missing email signature in Outlook, you can refer to Ticket ID: TKT-106. The resolution involved deploying the standard department signature template via the email signature tool and confirming that it appeared correctly when the new hire logged in. 

Ticket ID: TKT-106.

results.question: Computer is running very slowly after Windows update
results.answer:
To fix slow computer performance after a Windows update, you can refer to Ticket ID: TKT-095. The resolution involved rolling back a broken generic Bluetooth driver that was causing issues across the office fleet. This suggests that after a Windows update, checking for driver issues and rolling back to a previous known-good version may help improve performance. 

Resolution: Confirmed the update had shipped a broken generic Bluetooth driver. Rolled back the driver to the previous known-good version fleet-wide via SCCM and blocked the problematic driver update from redeploying until the vendor issued a fix. 

Ticket ID: TKT-095.

results.question: Cannot install Adobe Acrobat on my work laptop
results.answer:
Based on Ticket ID: TKT-151, the issue of being unable to install an application on a work laptop is addressed. The resolution involved confirming that the laptop was under a standard-user policy that blocks local-admin installs. Instead of granting standing admin rights, the approved application package was pushed through the Company Portal / Software Center for installation under the system account. 

If you are facing a similar issue with Adobe Acrobat, you may need to check if the application is approved and can be installed through the Software Center.

results.question: WiFi keeps dropping in the conference room
results.answer:
The issue of WiFi dropping in the conference room may be related to network configuration or coverage. Based on Ticket ID: TKT-130, a Wi-Fi site survey was conducted to confirm adequate coverage in a new conference room build-out, and the network was tested before handing it over. If there are ongoing issues, it may be beneficial to conduct a similar survey or check the configuration. 

Resolution from Ticket ID: TKT-130: "Coordinated with facilities to terminate the new network drops, configured switch ports for the room's AV controller and camera, ran a Wi-Fi site survey to confirm adequate coverage, and tested a full Teams meeting from the room before handing it over."

results.question: Account locked after too many wrong password attempts
results.answer:
To unlock your account after multiple incorrect password attempts, you can follow the resolution from Ticket ID: TKT-067. In that case, the user's identity was verified in person, and they were walked to the badge office to reissue a working smart card. Additionally, the PIN counter was reset, and the new card was re-enrolled to their account, allowing them to log in successfully. 

If you need further assistance, please contact your IT support team.

results.question: AnyConnect shows login failed after password reset
results.answer:
Based on Ticket ID: TKT-001, the resolution for a similar issue states that the user's Active Directory account was locked due to repeated failed MFA prompts. The account was unlocked in AD, the Duo MFA device pairing was reset, and it was confirmed that AnyConnect connected successfully to the GR-VPN gateway. 

If you are experiencing a login failure after a password reset, it may be worth checking if your account is locked or if there are issues with MFA.
